passages.text: COPD is a group of lung diseases that get worse over time. The most common COPD types are emphysema and chronic bronchitis.
Frequent coughing or wheezing. Shortness of breath doing everyday activities. Trouble taking deep breaths. Excess phlegm or mucus.
